message.content: Starting triage on the stored energy violation — shrinking it to a minimal case.
Shrink isolated a single bouncing case. I'll confirm it replays and inspect the violation.
First violating step shows inflated upward velocity. I'll look back to trace the energy gain.
The bounce appears to add energy rather than dissipate. I'll gather pre-impact history to confirm.
Incoming versus outgoing speeds point to an energy-gaining bounce. I'll check earlier steps.
I see a super-elastic floor bounce gaining energy; I'll capture the initial state for the baseline before testing a fix.
The outgoing speed exceeds what restitution allows, so I'll run a counterfactual with zero restitution to verify the bounce is the cause.
